title: Small talk
note: Ryan version; everything draft. Story: Ryan has just moved to the player's team. Four scenes, each a prompted start still, a prompted end still and one 8 s Veo clip retimed to 6 s (params.fitSeconds); story 1 (he carries in a box of his desk things with his medal on top, sets it down two desks away and hangs the medal on his monitor) is the hero shot (1080p); story 2 he takes an empty mug to the kitchen and the player follows; story 3 his phone lights up on the counter; story 4 he presses brew and glances over. No readable text anywhere: the medal, the ribbon and the box are plain objects, the kitchen has no clock, and his phone screen is only a blank glow. The dog photo is the one still that never goes into a video: card-dog-photo is drawn by the app inside the story-3 lock-screen card. The player is the faceless purple silhouette from Leave; stills that show it pass img/you.png as the first style reference, and every still passes flow-assets/boss-meter-calm.png for Marcus's drawing style. Later stills pass an earlier still as a third reference so the office and kitchen stay the same; the story 1 and 2 stills use the Pro image model (params.model: pro) because Flash kept refusing (IMAGE_OTHER) or drawing Ryan twice. Ryan's meter faces and moments live on his character sheet (item ryan-sheet). The phone-buzz card is drawn by the app. Voice ids follow the roleplay file: opening and coffee-ready are shared; guided-u1/guided-t2 are reused by Time's up; awkward-t5 is also the meter's lose line. The old draft stills are in .context/old-stills/small-talk/ (Elena) and .context/old-stills/small-talk-qa/ (Ryan, before the move-to-team story).
